summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, announcing senior management changes. Executive Vice President of Transition Energies Bayron Arley Triana Arias submitted voluntary resignation effective July 31, 2026, with Ernesto Alfonso Gómez Cabarcas acting from August 1 until permanent appointment. Corporate VP of Organizational Talent Victoria Irene Sepúlveda Ballesteros remains through August 31, then Juan Pablo Amaya Ibáñez acts from September 1. No financial terms, recommendation, or advisors. The changes are orderly and voluntary, not abrupt. Watch for permanent appointments and impacts on energy transition strategy.
